# fxp-go

> fast-xml-parser for Go (github.com/ofershap/fxp-go): tolerant XML to
> JSON-marshalable maps with no structs and no schema work, matching
> fast-xml-parser 5.12.1 byte-exactly (83-case golden corpus generated from
> the JS engine, quirks included). Parse, validate, and build XML. Standard
> library only, no dependencies.

## Usage

- fxp.New(fxp.DefaultOptions()).Parse(xml): XML string to map[string]any, tolerant of malformed input.
- fxp.Validate(xml): well-formedness check when you need strictness first.
- fxp.NewBuilder(fxp.DefaultBuildOptions()).Build(v): maps back to XML with escaped text/attribute content.
- One intentional divergence from the JS engine, pinned by TestDivergenceBareLtSpace.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/fxp-go#readme): install, examples, parity corpus, security notes, Q&A
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ofershap/fxp-go): library API
